topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Viewpoint Shift
lecture_lines: Think of a cat on a rug.
animations: Fade in camera perspective shifting using #FFFFFF.
Highlight the relative coordinate difference using #00FF00.

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Basis as Building Blocks
lecture_lines: Basis vectors are simple building blocks.
Skewed grids represent new basis vectors.
animations: Show vector space basis vectors #FF4500 with as the background reference.
Label origin and basis vectors clearly #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Change of Basis Matrix (P)
lecture_lines: Change of basis needs a translator.
Matrix P holds new basis vectors.
Old coordinates equal P times new.
animations: Animate P mapping old to new basis vectors #FFD700.
Show the translator bridging two systems #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Practical Application: Coordinate Conversion
lecture_lines: Finding new coordinates requires matrix inversion.
animations: Apply inverse P to map local to global #FF8C00.
Compare initial and transformed coordinates side-by-side #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary & Geometric Intuition
animations: Consolidate all matrices into unified frame #FFFFFF.
Link geometric intuition to coordinate values #FFD700.
